in_hebrew.name: Jeu
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Dedicated to Jupiter
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jeu הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Iuppiter', meaning 'Jupiter', the king of the gods in Roman mythology. In Christianity, Jupiter is symbolically associated with God as the supreme ruler of the universe.

in_greek.name: Jeu
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Dedicated to Jupiter
in_greek.long_meaning: Jeu είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name 'Iuppiter', meaning 'Jupiter', the king of the gods in Roman mythology. In Christianity, Jupiter is symbolically associated with God as the supreme ruler of the universe.

in_latin.name: Jeu
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Dedicated to Jupiter
in_latin.long_meaning: Jeu est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name 'Iuppiter', meaning 'Jupiter', the king of the gods in Roman mythology. In Christianity, Jupiter is symbolically associated with God as the supreme ruler of the universe.
